context.content:
I live in rural Norway, and I was highly disappointed when I got Pokémon Go and saw exactly no Pokémon nearby. I went outside and started walking with the game open. Five kilometers down the road, now two kilometers from the nearest residential area, I found my first encounter. 
This seems like a strange gameplay choice. Why can't I climb the mountains around me to find rock types? Why aren't large grass plains populated by Taurus, Ponyata? Why isn't there a Gyarados in the world's 4. highest waterfall we have here? 
I go to work every day, and have been taking walks around after work to play the game at all, but why can't I walk in the great outdoors at home, near my family farm? When did all Pokémon become city dwellers?
